name: 49286 · Tecumseh, MI
findings: ZIP 49286 (Tecumseh) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49286 (Tecumseh) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 49286 (Tecumseh) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).
